items.exampleEn: The baby is asleep in her room.
items.exampleZh: 寶寶在她房間裡睡著了。

items.exampleEn: Please write your name and occupation here.
items.exampleZh: 請在這裡寫上你的姓名和職業。

items.exampleEn: The captain of the ship welcomed us.
items.exampleZh: 那艘船的船長歡迎我們。

items.exampleEn: The clerk at the bank was very helpful.
items.exampleZh: 銀行的行員非常樂於幫忙。

items.exampleEn: The boss gave us a bonus for our hard work.
items.exampleZh: 老闆因為我們工作認真，發給我們獎金。

items.exampleEn: I always feel sleepy after lunch.
items.exampleZh: 我午餐後總是覺得很睏。

items.sentenceEn: I was asleep when you called me.
items.sentenceZh: 你打電話給我的時候，我已經睡著了。

items.audioEn: As a hotel clerk, I work from three in the afternoon until midnight.
items.audioZh: 我是旅館櫃台人員，從下午三點工作到半夜。

items.sentenceEn: He is the captain of our basketball team.
items.sentenceZh: 他是我們籃球隊的隊長。

items.sentenceEn: I'm so sleepy. Let's go home.

items.stemEn: She was so tired that she fell ____ on the bus.
items.stemZh: 她累到在公車上睡著了。

items.stemEn: What is your ____? — I'm a nurse.
items.stemZh: 你的職業是什麼？——我是護理師。

items.passageEn: David is a businessman. For many years, he worked long hours and slept only five hours a night. He was always sleepy at work, and he often fell asleep in meetings. Last year, he got a big bonus, but he wasn't happy. So he changed his lifestyle. Now he goes to bed early and walks every morning. "Money isn't everything," he says.
items.passageZh: David 是個生意人。他有很多年都工作很長的時間，每晚只睡五個小時。他上班時總是很睏，開會時還常常睡著。去年他拿到一大筆獎金，卻不快樂。於是他改變了生活方式。現在他很早上床睡覺，每天早上去散步。他說：「錢不是一切。」

questions.questionZh: David 以前上班時常常怎樣？
options: 常跟同事在會議上吵架
換了一份比較輕鬆的工作

items.promptZh: 那位店員幫我找到了合適的尺寸。
referenceEn: The clerk helped me find the right size.
The clerk helped me to find the right size.
rubricZh: help＋人＋（to）原形動詞（例如 helped me find、helped me to find）
說過去的事用過去式（例如 helped）

items.instructionZh: 用 lifestyle 造一個句子，說說你現在或你想要的生活方式。
referenceEn: I want to have a healthier lifestyle.
My lifestyle is very busy because of work.
rubricZh: lifestyle 是名詞「生活方式」（例如 a healthy lifestyle、my lifestyle）
主詞和動詞要搭配（例如 My lifestyle is）
